description: Create a persistent design session under the host project root. Pass designId, profile (alias or ref), operationId, and optional decisions. Pins and hash-verifies the packaged macro registry. Idempotent for the same operationId. Oversized optional receipt fields may be omitted with truncated:true after commit.

decisions.description: Initial architectural decisions for the session (e.g. density, stylePack, responsive breakpoints).

designId.description: Unique identifier for the new design session (slug format, e.g. "workspace-v1").

profile.description: Target rhythm/scaffold profile or recipe alias (e.g. "workspace-dashboard", "executive-dashboard").

name: begin_design
